name: Agrius Threat Group Targets Israeli Entities With Wiper Malware Camouflaged as Ransomware
description: an Iranian advanced persistent threat (APT) group, "Agrius." Researchers noted they have been tracking Agrius’ operations in Israel since 2020 and at first that their attacks were conducted using a wiper malware called Apostle.
